column3: Held up early - improving from 2f out and pressed for effort inside final furlong - powered through late to score
Tracked the front-runner - under strong driving from 3f out - hit the front over 1f out - collared inside the final furlong and found no more
Settled around midfield - pushed along with 2f left - stayed on from inside final furlong - finished third
Set the pace early - pushed clear approaching 2f out then lost the advantage inside the final furlong and dropped away to finish fourth
Settled off the pace - pushed along with over 2f left - dropped away inside final furlong - finished 5th
Sat close to the pace early - pushed along with 2f remaining - dropped away soon after - finished sixth well beaten
Sluggish start - trailed the field throughout - never featured - finished a well-held seventh

Away smartly and eager to go early - close up with the front group before hitting the front after a furlong - asked for effort with a furlong and a half left - driven inside final furlong and drifted right - held on well to win
Close to the pace early - urged forward approaching final furlong - found extra inside last 110yds to move into second - stayed on to the line
Hit front early - overtaken before 1f - held handy spot - stayed in pursuit of winner from the 1f pole - battled on gamely - edged out of second close home
Held up towards the back - driven into contention entering the last furlong - stayed on strongly inside the final 110yds but unable to get to the front runners
Settled towards the back - progress late inside the final furlong - stayed on without the speed to get involved close home - finished fifth beaten 4 lengths
Held a forward spot early - slipped back through the pack after 2f - short of space approaching 2f out - lost touch inside final furlong - faded to finish sixth
Held up midpack - crept forward through the middle 2f out - faded late to finish seventh
Held up in mid-division - urged forward with 1f left - dropped away rapidly close home - finished 8th
Settled at the back of the field early - never featured in the finish - beaten well over 9 lengths in 9th
Hampered and hesitant leaving the stalls - settled at the back and lost touch after halfway - well adrift late before falling inside the final furlong
Sent forward early - lost front spot before 1f - sat third at halfway - urged on approaching 2f out - driven with a furlong left - hit front inside final 100 yards and stayed on strongly to win

Sat behind pace early - moved through to front after 1f - challenged hard 2f out - driven and overtaken inside final furlong - slipped to third with 150 yards left before finishing revival gets second on the line

Up with the front group early - moved to 2nd by halfway - pressed for the lead over 2f out and hit the front over 1f out - soon found little and fell back to 3rd inside the final 100 yards - plugged on at the one speed

Sat close to the front pack early - 6th at halfway - urged forward on the outside turning into the straight - up to 4th over 2f out but looked unfurnished with a furlong left - one-paced finish for 4th
Sat just off the front group early - 5th at halfway - asked for effort with 2f left then stayed on same gear to the line without finding more
Held up towards back of pack - moved into 7th two out and pushed up to 6th inside final two furlongs - stayed on same gait to finish
Held up towards the back - urged into effort with 2f left - late gain in the closing stages to finish 7th
Sat close to the front group early - 4th at halfway - asked for effort into the straight but couldn't land a blow from 2f out home
Settled midpack early - dropped towards the back by halfway - unable to close from over 2f out - finished well held in 9th
Settled in the pack - urged forward with over 2f left - found little in response and dropped away inside the final furlong - eventually finished tenth
Settled at the back early - unable to make an impression - beaten a long way by the finish
Held up towards the back - 7th at halfway - dropped away inside final 2f - well held late
Sat behind pace early - urged into front two out - opened daylight approaching final furlong - allowed to coast home unchallenged
Settled towards the back - pushed along with 2f left - finished well without quite closing to win
Settled around midfield - improved into contention over 2f out under pressure - stayed on same gear from the final furlong to finish third
Set the pace unchallenged - pressed for effort 2f out before being overtaken - faded inside final furlong to finish fourth
Sat close to pace early - pressed for effort with 2f left then dropped away inside final furlong
Held up early - never a factor - came home well beaten in 6th
Held up at the back throughout - never a factor - finished 7th
Handy early - upped tempo on the front pair 4f out - hit the front with 2f left - driven clear late to win

Held up towards the back - driven approaching final 2f - moved across nearing the final furlong - lost balance closing in on the front pack inside the last furlong - grabbed second close home but unable to get to the winner
Held up towards the back - improved position from 2f out - closed on the front group inside final furlong - stayed on to grab third late
Settled close to the pace - improved wide to share the front around 2f out - eased back to finish fourth as the winner went on
Settled towards the back - lost touch with the pace 3f out and drifted right approaching the final furlong - faded soon after finishing fifth
Went straight to the front - driven when overtaken 2f out then lost place approaching the furlong marker - dropped away close home
Handy early with the pace - asked for effort 2f out - lost ground final furlong and dropped away close home
Settled at the back early - driven approaching 2f out but lost touch with rivals - dropped away in the closing stages to finish well beaten
Sat handy behind the front pair - moved into second after 2f then went on 2f out - driven out and stayed on to win from over 1f out
Sat just behind front rank - 5th at halfway - urged forward approaching 2f out - moved into second inside final furlong but stayed on same gait to the line
Held up towards back of field - moved into 6th spot approaching 2f out then pushed wide to reach 3rd inside final furlong - held level thereafter finishing third
Sat behind the front group early - asked for effort in 3rd approaching final 2f before slipping to 4th inside the last furlong - stayed on at the same rate for 4th
Held up towards the back - cajoled forward on the inner from 2f out - nudged up to 6th over 1f out then advanced to 5th inside the final 150 yards - one-paced in the closing stages to finish fifth
Sat just behind the front group - 7th at halfway - asked for effort over 2f out and stayed on at one speed to the line

Sat close to the front pair early - moved through to hit the front after 1f before being overtaken 2f out - asked for effort but found little in 5th a furlong later - dropped away inside the final furlong
Held up towards the back - driven for effort with 2f to go - asked again inside final furlong but unable to make headway
Held up towards back - urged forward on the outside approaching final 2f - driven with a furlong left but unable to close - finished well held in 9th
Settled midfield - 6th at halfway - asked for effort into straight but found nothing and dropped away over 2f out
Held up at the back - made no impression - well held throughout
Sat close to the front group early - third at halfway then fourth and asked for effort over 2f out - dropped away rapidly inside the final furlong to finish well held
Settled towards the back - made progress from 2f out after being angled wide and pushed along - powered clear inside the final furlong to win
Went straight to front - pushed along 2f out and battled on under urging - overtaken deep inside final furlong to finish second by a half-length
Sat close behind pacesetter early - pressed for effort with 3f left and looked poised to strike a furlong out - couldn't find more late and held for third
Settled off the pace early - pushed along with 2f left - closed on the front group approaching the final furlong - squeezed for space late but stayed on to finish 4th
Sat close behind the front group - pressed for effort with two furlongs left - stayed on at the same rate through the closing stages - finished fifth beaten just under four lengths
Settled midfield early - pressed for effort with 2f left - stayed on at one speed through the final furlong to finish 6th beaten 4 lengths
Settled off the pace - pushed along with 2f left - faded inside final furlong to finish 7th
Held up towards the back - pressed for effort with 3f left - stayed on without gaining ground from 2f out - finished eighth
Settled in the pack - pressed for effort with 2f left - unable to find more inside final furlong - finished ninth beaten 6½ lengths
Sluggish start - held up towards the back of the field throughout - never a factor and beaten home in 10th
Settled towards the back - pushed along with 3f left - made no real impression - finished well beaten in 11th
Held up at the back throughout - never able to make an impression - well held at the finish

Settled off the pace in the pack early - fought for control before halfway - moved smoothly to reach the front-runner 3f out - went ahead 2f from home - drew away with little urging inside the final furlong - impressive winner

Held mid-pack early - drifted left with four furlongs left - moved through towards the middle from three out and went a length up over two out - overtaken soon after - stayed on but couldn't match winner's finish approaching the last furlong

Shared front early - moved in front after 2f and opened up by halfway - advantage narrowed 3f out - overtaken inside final 2f - unable to match the front two approaching the furlong marker - stayed on for third
Shared the front spot early - settled second by the 2f marker - urged into effort 3f from home - lost touch over the final two furlongs and dropped away
Settled fourth early - lost touch with leaders over 2f out - dropped away late - finished fifth
Held up at the back - lost touch and dropped away after 3f - found a bit more late on to finish 6th
Settled in the pack - hampered with 4f left then knocked about again 2f out - edged forward through the middle 3f out - lost ground final furlong to finish 7th
Sluggish start - held up towards the back - dropped well adrift with a furlong to go - well held at the finish
Settled third early - driven when dropping back 4f out - dropped away steadily from 2f out and beaten well home
Held up towards the back - improving position moving to the middle of the track - came down hard around 2f out
Tracked the front pair early - still second at halfway - improved to share command with two furlongs left - driven on to hit the front inside the final furlong and stayed on strongly to win
Sat handy behind front pair - third at halfway - asked for effort approaching final two furlongs and moved into second inside the last - held on for a one-paced finish to place second
Held up at the back - asked for effort over 2f out then found finishing energy inside the final furlong - up into 3rd near the line
Went straight to front - urged forward entering straight - caught two out then slipped back to third - unable to find more and edged out of the frame late
Sat behind the pace early - mid-pack around halfway - urged forward wide of rivals with 2f left - improved into contention inside the final furlong - held on well but faded and finished 5th
Sat close to front pack early - 5th at halfway - urged on with 2f left - found nothing more inside the final furlong and slipped to 6th close home
Sat close to the pace early - asked for effort over 2f out and moved into 4th inside the final furlong - had nothing more and dropped away close home
Sat behind front group early - 4th at halfway - asked for effort over 2f out but found little in response - dropped away inside final furlong to finish 8th
Held up towards the back - unable to close from over 2f out - finished well held in 9th
Settled in the pack early - urged forward approaching 2f out - driven soon after but unable to close from 1f out - finished well held in 10th
Held up towards the back - unable to challenge from 2f out - well held at the finish
Held up towards the back of the pack - 9th at halfway - dropped away with 2f left - eventually well held in 12th
Held up towards the back of the pack - unable to close from over 2f out - beaten well into 13th
Held up at the back - no impression made - well held throughout
Stumbled at the break - settled just behind the pace - angled right and driven to the front a furlong out - eased clear to score
Slow to keep tempo early and settled at the back - pushed along with 2f left and made headway wide - closed strongly to finish 2nd beaten 3 lengths
Held a midfield position early - pressed for effort inside final two furlongs - finished strongly through the last furlong to take third
Shared front spot early - pushed along over 2f out and went in front - lost advantage a furlong out then dropped away close home - finished fourth
Settled towards the back and tugging hard early - moved into contention behind the front group after 2f - pushed along with 2f left - lost momentum in the final furlong to finish fifth
Shared front spot early - pushed along and lost command with 2f left - dropped away inside final furlong
Settled towards the rear early - pushed along with 2f left - dropped away and slowed near the final furlong - finished seventh
Settled off the pace - pressed for effort with 2f left - dropped away inside the final furlong - eventually finished eighth

Broke on top and dictated from the front - extended advantage to two lengths approaching 3f out - pushed along inside the final furlong - kept finding under pressure - edged closer to the line in the last 110yds - won going away

Up with the early pace - eased back through the field after 2f - last and under pressure before halfway - pulled out and progressed 3f out - ran on well over 1f out and into second inside the final 110yds - kept on but unable to peg back the winner

Held up towards the back - moved to the middle of the track and improved into second with a right-side drift 2f out - drifted again pressing the leader inside the final furlong then faded out of the frame late
Hesitant start and left trailing behind - urged forward to link with the pack after 2f - made gradual progress from 3f out to finish fourth
Settled in the pack early - made progress 4f out to briefly hold second past 2f out - pushed along and dropped back approaching final furlong - faded to finish fifth
mid-pack for most of the way - stayed on inside final furlong but couldn't reach the front group - finished 6th
Held up at the back - driven approaching 3f out then lost ground 2f out - dropped away inside final furlong
Settled close up early in second - asked for effort 3f out but found little and dropped back - faded final furlong - well held in 8th
Held a forward spot early - carried wide approaching the home turn 4f out - pressed for effort 3f out - lost touch with the pace 2f out and dropped away

Held up towards the back early - moved closer to the front group by the 2f mark - urged forward 3f from home - lost momentum and faded 2f out - slipped to the back and allowed to drop away inside the final furlong
Settled behind pace - disputed second at halfway then edged in front 2f out - driven out to assert and stay on strongly to win
Towards back of the field - still 10th at halfway - urged forward entering straight and asked for effort 2f out - improved into 3rd inside final furlong - stayed on for 2nd near the line
Held up in the back half - driven into contention from 2f out - stayed on strongly inside the final furlong to claim 3rd on the line
Sat just behind the pace - urged into 5th with 2f left - shaken up to move into second inside the final furlong - flattened out in the last 100 yards and slipped back to finish fourth
Held up towards the back - driven on inside approaching 2f out to reach 4th inside the final furlong - couldn't find more and slipped back to finish 5th
Held up towards the back - urged into action with 2f left and stayed on late - improved to finish 6th
Held up towards the back - urged forward with two furlongs left - driven wide a furlong out - stayed on to take 7th late
Sat behind the pace - third at halfway - driven with two out and unable to quicken - dropped away in the last furlong
Sat close to the front group early - moved up to 3rd approaching 2f out but soon flattened out in 4th - dropped away in the closing stages
Settled midpack early - driven approaching 2f out - unable to close from 1f out - finished well held
Held up towards the back - driven wide with two furlongs left - urged on inside the final furlong but unable to close - well held at the finish
Went straight to front - lost the advantage approaching 2f out under pressure - eased back through the field inside the final furlong - well held at the finish
Sat close to the pace - 7th at halfway - asked for effort over 2f out and faded from a furlong out
Sat handy behind front group - 8th at halfway then asked for effort with 2f left - lost ground final furlong to finish well beaten
Settled in the pack early - moved up to 6th by halfway - driven approaching final 2f then dropped away inside final furlong
Held up at the back - made no impression - well held in 16th
Sat close to the pace - 4th at halfway - driven with 2f left then faded from 1f out to finish 17th
Held up early - stayed at the back of the field throughout - no impression made on the finish
Settled just behind the front group early - pushed along with 2f left - powered home late to get up right on the line
Settled midpack early - pressed for effort with 2f left and closed on the pace - hit the front inside the last furlong - caught right on the line for second
Set the early gallop on the far rails - edged in front there - pressed for effort with 2f left - lost the advantage inside the final furlong but battled on to finish third beaten a length and a half
Broke to the right early - settled in the pack - pushed along over 2f out and finished with running on well inside final furlong
Settled off the pace early - pushed along with 2f left and closed on the front group - unable to find more inside the final furlong to finish 5th
Hesitant start - dropped back and lost touch with the pace - urged along with 2f left - responded to finish strongest of all late on
Settled in the pack - pushed along with 2f left and caught up in a bump - responded to find another gear in the closing stages - finished seventh without threatening the front
Hampered and behind at the off - held up towards the back - pushed along with 2f left and moved right to make progress inside final furlong - unable to find more late finished 8th
Sluggish out of the gate - stayed at the back of the field throughout - finished ninth well beaten
Sat close to the front early - pushed along with 3f left - dropped away steadily from 2f out to finish well held
Held prominent spot early travelling wide of rivals - drifted off a true line 2f out - backed off inside final furlong to finish well held
Broke smartly and set the pace - driven approaching final furlong - jostled and pressed inside final 110yds - lost advantage briefly inside final 50yds - dug deep to regain command on the line

Sluggish start - settled towards back - made smooth progress from 2f out - into second with a furlong left - drifted across and clipped rival inside final 110yds - hit front for a stride close home before being caught right on the line
Held up towards the back - driven wide to improve over 2f out - closed on the front group inside the final furlong but lacked the speed to get on terms and settled for third
Held mid-pack early - driven approaching 2f out and edged into contention - lost momentum inside final furlong then dropped away - finished fourth well beaten
Settled in the pack - pressed the front group passing the furlong marker - lost momentum inside the last and faded to finish fifth
Held up at the back throughout - lost touch before halfway and fell further adrift from 2f out - edged ahead of one fading runner in the closing stages to finish sixth
Settled second early - urged for effort 2f out then dropped away over a furlong out - trailed home well held
Sat close to the front group early - fifth of the field at the halfway point - asked for effort inside the final furlong and responded strongly - hit the front just before the line to score
Settled midpack early - urged forward wide of rivals with two furlongs left - improved into 5th approaching the final furlong - stayed on well to snatch second right at the line
Up with the pace from the off - hit the front over 2f out - driven and stayed on into the final furlong - nothing more to give and overtaken 50 yards out - faded to 3rd

Settled towards the back of the pack - 6th at the halfway stage - urged forward approaching 2f out then squeezed for space with a furlong left - checked a touch and driven out 100 yards from home - stayed on well to finish 4th
Sat behind the pace - 3rd at halfway - asked for effort 2f out and 4th - held no more inside final furlong finishing 5th
Held up in the pack - still 10th with 2f left - urged into effort inside final furlong - stayed on to snatch 6th near the line
Sat close to pace early - asked for effort in 3rd approaching 2f out - shifted into 2nd inside final furlong - flattened out and squeezed for room 100 yards out finishing 4th
Towards the back - short of racing room on multiple occasions from over 1f out - not persevered with near the line
Held up towards the back - urged into effort with over 2f left - couldn't find any extra and made no headway from the furlong marker - finished well held
Took the lead early - pressed and displaced over 2f out - dropped away in the final furlong to finish 10th
Held up at the back - no impression made on leaders - well held at finish
Set the pace from the off - driven along with two furlongs remaining and edged clear - dug in strongly to hold the advantage to the line
Sat close to the front - pushed along with two furlongs left and still in contention approaching the final furlong - unable to find more late and held for second
Settled at the back - pushed along with 2f left - stayed on same gear through the last furlong - finished third
Sat close to front pack - pushed along with 2f left - lost ground inside final furlong to finish 4th
Sat handy behind pace-setters - pushed along with 2f left - lost momentum inside final furlong - finished fifth
Up with the pace early - moved to front and drew ahead over 3f out - pushed along over 1f out - stayed on strongly to win

Sat behind the front pack early - short of space and under pressure two out - urged forward inside the final furlong to move up to second while a touch inexperienced - stayed on strongly to finish second beaten a length
Fought for control early - sat close to front group - urged forward with 2f left - stayed on inside final furlong to finish third
Prompt out of gate - shared pace early - lost advantage over 3f out - veered right 2f out and drifted markedly right inside the final furlong - flattened out to finish 4th
Missed the break and drifted right from the stalls - settled at the back - niggled into contention 2f out - angled right over 1f out before plugging on at one tempo to finish 5th
Settled mid-pack early - urged forward approaching 3f out - failed to close and knocked off stride inside final furlong - finished sixth
Settled close to the pace - pushed along with 2f left - dropped away in the final furlong - finished seventh
Hesitant start and drifted right exiting the gate - stayed unfurnished at the back for the remainder - well held at the finish
Went straight to front early - challenged hard with two furlongs left - pushed out and stayed on gamely inside final furlong to prevail
Settled in the pack early - improved into 4th by halfway - urged into 3rd approaching the final 2f - driven inside the last furlong and edged into 2nd close home - finished second beaten 1.75 lengths
Sat behind the pace - mid-pack in 7th at halfway - asked for effort with 2f left and stayed on through the final furlong - grabbed 3rd near the line
Sat behind the front group - 5th at halfway - asked for effort with 2f left - stayed on late to take 4th
Sat just behind the pace - disputed 2nd at halfway - moved up to press the front two over 2f out - couldn't quicken and lost place approaching the finish
Held up towards the back - 10th at halfway - driven on the inner 2f out - stayed on inside the final furlong to finish 6th
Handy behind front group early - 3rd at halfway - fourth and driven approaching 2f out - lost place inside final furlong to finish 7th
Held up towards the back - urged forward with two furlongs left - stayed on under pressure late to finish eighth
Held up towards the back of the pack - moved into 6th by halfway - asked for effort over 2f out - had nothing more and dropped away near the finish
Held up in the pack - urged forward approaching 2f out - stayed under pressure and made slight late progress inside final furlong - finished 10th beaten 6 lengths
Sat close to front group early - 8th at halfway - asked for effort over 2f out but found little more - dropped away inside final furlong to finish 11th
Held up towards the back - urged forward with a furlong left - edged closer late but never threatening - finished 12th
Held up towards the back - driven up 2f out - unable to make headway inside the final furlong - finished well held in 13th
Settled midfield early - slipped back to 12th by halfway - asked for effort in the straight but found nothing from over 2f out and finished well held
Sat close to the front rank early - slipped towards the back around halfway - unable to make ground from over 2f out - finished well beaten in 15th
Sat close to pace early - slipped back through the field by halfway - driven approaching final 2f but had nothing left and faded
Held up at the back - no impression made - well held throughout
Settled at the back early - made progress into contention over 2f out - pushed along inside final furlong - stayed on to hit the front close home
Settled midfield - pushed along with 2f left - stayed on to hit front inside final 110yds - pipped close home
settled in the pack - pushed along with 2f left - progressed to dispute the lead a furlong out - stayed on to the line finishing third by a half-length

Handy near the front - pushed along 3f out then edged right and found space inside final 2f - closed on the leading pair approaching the last furlong - flattened out in the closing stages to finish fourth
Sat behind the front group - pushed along two out - hit the front approaching final furlong - overtaken close home and faded
Raced with plenty of enthusiasm early - set the pace before being pressed 2f out - drifted right and lost front spot inside final 2f - lost pace close home to finish sixth beaten 3.5 lengths
Held up at the back throughout - never a threat - finished 7th
held mid-pack early - pushed along with 2f left - dropped away inside final furlong to finish eighth
Sat close to the pace early - pushed along with 2f left - dropped away inside the final furlong - eventually well held in 9th
Held up towards the back - still 7th at halfway - urged into contention over 2f out to hit the front inside the final furlong - stayed on strongly to score
Held up towards the back early - still only 6th at halfway - moved up on the inner into 4th though squeezed for space with a furlong left - stayed on to snatch second near the line
Sent clear early - urged 2f out and lost command approaching final furlong - couldn't find more and eased back to third late on
Sat behind front pair - moved into 2nd over 2f out then eased back to 3rd inside final furlong - held no more late and edged out of the frame near the line
Slow to break - held up at the back - urged forward with over 2f left - pressed for effort inside the final furlong - stayed on to take 5th late
Sat behind the front group - asked for more effort over 2f out but found little and held 5th a furlong out - eased back to finish 6th
Tracked the pace early - up to 2nd by halfway then driven into 3rd approaching 2f out - found nothing and faded inside the last furlong
Settled in the pack - 5th at halfway - asked for effort early in the straight but found nothing inside the final two furlongs - dropped away late
Settled mid-pack early - made progress on pacesetters four out - shared front spot three out - moved in charge two out - pushed further ahead after the last - finished off strongly to score

Settled in the pack early - improved into contention 4 out - shared the front 3 out - pressed for effort 2 out - tracked the front pair after the last - edged into second close home but never troubling the winner

Tracked the pace early - lost momentum briefly around the 4th - hit front approaching 3 out then matched for the lead - lost that position and stumbled again 2 out - pushed out after the last but faded to finish third
Held up towards the back - made progress after 4 out to move into fourth before 3 out - up with the front group 2 out - lost place after the last and dropped away on the run-in
Held up towards the back - nudged into contention 3 out and up with the front group but drifted right at the last - lost momentum on the run-in to finish 5th
Up with the pace early - lost ground approaching 3 out - dropped well behind from 2 out - finished sixth well beaten
Went straight to front and dictated matters - lost command on the bend approaching three out - soon dropped away and beaten a long way
Held a forward spot early - under pressure and losing touch before 3 out - well adrift by 2 out - finished last of all beaten a long way
Held up towards back - fell at 1st
Held up towards the back - isolated on own early on then slipped further behind into 8th and found nothing - eventually well beaten and pulled up before 3 out
Settled just off the pace after a strong early pull - roused along inside the final furlong - hit the front late - kept finding under pressure to the line - won going away
Settled just behind the pace - urged forward with 2f left - made ground into second inside final furlong - stayed on but denied by a narrow margin
Settled in the pack - headway and moved into contention from 2f out - kept on into third but edged out near the line
Settled at the back early - pushed along 2f out - gained ground final furlong - moved into fourth close home
Settled at back of field - pushed along with 2f left - progress late inside final furlong - grabbed fifth close home but no real impact on the finish
Sent clear early - lost front spot but stayed close - back in command 2f out - driven approaching final furlong - overtaken again and faded near the line finishing sixth
Settled towards the back - pushed to improve with 4f left - asked for effort 2f out but made no impact - finished well beaten in 7th
Settled in the front rank early - hit the front approaching 2f then pushed along and lost command with 2f left - dropped away over the final furlong to finish eighth
Settled in the pack early - pushed along with two furlongs left - unable to close the gap late
Sat close behind the pace - pushed along with 2f left - soon dropped away to finish 10th

Settled towards the back - made smooth progress from the fifth - moved through powerfully to hit the front 3 out - pushed on 2 out - opened up daylight before the last - kept finding more to the line for an easy success
Settled in the pack - squeezed for space approaching 3 out - moved into second before 2 out - driven out but held by winner late

Settled with the pace early - shared the front turning for home three out - lost ground before two out - pressed for effort approaching the last but unable to close on the winner - stayed on without threatening in third
Settled in the pack - lost touch approaching 3 out - pushed along after 2 out - kept plugging on same gear after the last to finish fourth
Held up towards the back - lost touch three out then found renewed effort after two out - stayed on at one gear finishing 5th
Settled in the pack early - made progress into contention after 4 out - pressed for effort before 3 out - lost touch with the front two out - clipped the last and faded through the finish
Handy early - shared front spot after 2nd then went clear after 4 out - overtaken before 3 out - hit the deck 2 out - dropped away soon after - finished 7th well beaten

Set the pace early - lost front spot after the 2nd then regained it before the 4th - overtaken once more before the 6th - lost control of the race approaching 3 out - drifted off the pace and needed urging into the last - dropped away steadily up the run-in
Held up at the back - urged forward before 3 out - well beaten from 2 out - eventually finished 9th
Handy early - shared front spot after 2nd before going clear after 4th - overtaken before 6th - dropped away fast after 4 out - blundered 3 out - beaten a long way home
Held up towards back - fifth from home found little and slipped to the tail - well behind before 3 out - finished well held
Settled close to the pace - pushed to the front inside final furlong - stayed on strongly to score
Settled in the pack early - improved position with 2f left - pushed along a furlong out and moved into second inside the final furlong - stayed on to finish second beaten a length
Settled towards the back - shifted right and looked for room 2f out - pushed along with a furlong left - closed strongly to grab third close home
Settled in the pack early - pushed along with two furlongs left - rallied inside the final furlong to edge into third - just failed to hold the spot at the line
Held up in the pack - driven approaching 2f out and closing 1f out - held late to finish 5th
Sent clear early - pressed for effort and lost front spot inside final 2f - dropped away in the closing stages
Sat close to the pace early - driven with two furlongs left - dropped away in the final furlong - finished seventh
Held up in the pack - pushed along with 2f left - unable to make any real headway - well held at the finish
